final: WITH m AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM m WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT m.rating, m.cnt FROM m CROSS JOIN avg_c WHERE m.cnt > avg_c.a) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_kept_count, AVG(cnt - (SELECT a FROM avg_c)) AS avg_deviation_from_mean FROM kept
